name: project_phase1
description: A closed-loop framework that turns a natural-language instruction into a validated sequence of drone skills, finds the objects it refers to with a vision-language model, grounds them in metres, flies there, and replans when the scene changes. The target vehicle is a LiteWing ESP32-S3 micro-quadrotor; development and evaluation run against a Simulink / Simscape Multibody / Unreal digital twin.
